problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages to load onto a cargo plane. The available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 9 m³, revenue $64
* Package 2: volume 3 m³, revenue $296
* Package 3: volume 6 m³, revenue $232
* Package 4: volume 30 m³, revenue $240
* Package 5: volume 26 m³, revenue $17
* Package 6: volume 48 m³, revenue $278
* Package 7: volume 41 m³, revenue $173
* Package 8: volume 46 m³, revenue $277
* Package 9: volume 14 m³, revenue $74
* Package 10: volume 40 m³, revenue $163
* Package 11: volume 36 m³, revenue $160
* Package 12: volume 44 m³, revenue $215
* Package 13: volume 39 m³, revenue $277
* Package 14: volume 49 m³, revenue $35
* Package 15: volume 30 m³, revenue $300
* Package 16: volume 16 m³, revenue $211
* Package 17: volume 17 m³, revenue $295
* Package 18: volume 43 m³, revenue $167
* Package 19: volume 48 m³, revenue $71
* Package 20: volume 21 m³, revenue $140
* Package 21: volume 45 m³, revenue $273
* Package 22: volume 18 m³, revenue $241
* Package 23: volume 29 m³, revenue $62

The aircraft's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 488 m³. Choose the combination of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume constraint. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
